title: Pink Alien on Lava Rock
description: A surreal creature with a pink head, large black eyes, and antennae stands on a mossy rock surrounded by flowing orange lava. The background features a swirling red and black vortex with floating white spheres, one of which has red polka dots matching the creature's egg-shaped white body with red spots.
prompt: A surreal pink alien creature with a large egg-shaped white body covered in red polka dots, big glossy black eyes, and long antennae with pink bulbs stands on a moss-covered rocky outcrop. Bright orange lava flows down the rock into a river below. Three white spheres float in the air against a swirling red and black vortex background that transitions to green at the bottom. Highly detailed, vibrant colors, whimsical and bizarre atmosphere.
